presentation.label: QUICK MOD ASSIGN
presentation.summary: Link a parameter to velocity, aftertouch or the LFO by holding FIX, SAMPLER or LFO and turning its knob.
presentation.overview: Hold FIX and turn any knob on a sound page: that parameter is linked to velocity, and the turn sets how much. Hold SAMPLER and turn to link it to aftertouch instead. While either key is held, every linked knob shows its amount the way stock shows a performance or scene lock. It fills stock's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots of the selected sound, so the links save with the kit, show in SOUND SETTINGS as usual and keep playing on a unit without the mod.
highlights: Velocity, aftertouch or the LFO to any parameter in one gesture
Stays on the page you are playing
Uses stock's slots, saved with the kit
usage: Select a sound track and press FLTR. Hold FIX: FRQ and RES show 0 boxes, the new kit's velocity links.
Keep FIX held and turn FRQ to the right: its box counts up and FRQ itself does not move. Play soft and hard hits: harder ones open the filter.
Press AMP, hold SAMPLER and turn DEC: pad pressure now lengthens the decay.
Hold FIX and press FRQ's knob: the link goes back to 0, and its slot is free for another parameter.
Press FLTR, hold LFO and turn FRQ: the LFO now moves the filter. Keep turning to set the depth, then let go and tap LFO: the LFO page shows DST FRQ.

access.location: The FIX and SAMPLER keys, on a sound track's pages and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO.
steps: Select a sound track and open its SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP or LFO page.
Hold FIX: linked knobs show their velocity amounts. Turn a knob to link it or change its amount.
Hold SAMPLER for aftertouch: the aftertouch amounts.
Turn back to 0 to free the slot. Tap FIX alone to toggle fixed velocity, tap SAMPLER alone to open the recorder, as before.

limitations: Each sound has four velocity and four aftertouch mods; with all four in use a popup says VELOCITY MODS FULL or AFTERTOUCH MODS FULL.
A FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release instead of the press.
While FIX or SAMPLER is held, the TRIG page's knobs, knobs turned with a trig held and FUNC + a knob do nothing.
FUNC + FIX, the FX track and a performance, scene or trig lock edit keep stock's behaviour.

claims: ui:FIX + knob on the sound pages
ui:SAMPLER + knob on the sound pages
ui:FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release
ui:LFO + knob on the sound pages and the FX track
ui:LFO page key shows its page on the release

load.conditions: Read from the code: it subscribes to ev_key, ev_enc and ev_tick only, never to the audio path. Each UI tick it checks whether FIX, SAMPLER or LFO is held and whether its locker is still set, a few compares; a held key's knob turns walk the sound's four mod slots. Not measured on a unit.

hardware.summary: On npp1993's Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, with npp1993's go for each run, Modwerk's test rig (key presses and knob turns sent over USB, screens read back) ran six cases on this source in QL13: LFO held and a knob turned makes that parameter the LFO's destination at depth 0 and the page stays; further turns set DEP exactly as the same turns of stock's DEP knob, and the knob's box shows it as the LFO page does (+1.93, -1.93, +127.99, (0)); another knob takes the LFO at 0, a knob press sets DEP to 0, and the parameters themselves do not move; NOT AN LFO DEST on the LFO page; FIX links as before; plain LFO taps give stock's screens and Loop Sync follows them. All passed (run 1 differed only on the screens changed on purpose, then --record and plain 6 pass). By hand on QL10 to QL13, npp1993 reports: the LFO moves FRQ, TUN and DEC; the FX track's LFO takes a delay or reverb knob; FIX and SAMPLER links and aftertouch as before; the depth box on label and widget knobs, one width; PERF mode assigns the LFO, a PERF pad held during an LFO hold makes stock's performance locks.
limitations: Six screen cases by the test rig; the by-hand checks are the author's report.
Tested beside Loop Sync on a development base with the test link (QL10, QL13), RAM-booted from the flashed OS; not alone, not flashed, no kit save, reload or power cycle on 0.2.0.
PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO screens with LFO held: PERF by hand only; SCNE, MUTE and CHRO in rytm-emu only.

tests.summary: rytm-emu on QM11 to QM13 and QM20/QL builds (0.2.0): links, lock-style display, MODS FULL, SAMPLER recorder, FIX toggle, PERF, SCNE, FX track, LFO assign, depth box. Author's unit: RC18, RC19 and QM12 alone (links, save, reload, power cycle) pass. 0.2.0 on the author's unit: the test rig's six cases on QL13 and the author's hand checks on QL10 to QL13 pass.

media.caption: Quick Mod Assign
media.alt: FIX plus a knob turn fills the first of four velocity mod slots with +20; SAMPLER plus a knob turn fills the first of four aftertouch slots with +10; LFO plus a knob turn makes SWT the LFO's destination with depth +12. A knob press sets a link to 0, and the links save with the kit.
